displayPattern: Shown on the control board 7-segment display: EE6 (furnace still operates)
meaning: Low flame signal: flame sense microamp signal is minimal.
causes: Flame sensor incorrectly positioned in burner flame
Lazy burner flame due to improper gas pressure or combustion air
diySteps: Technician: clean flame sensor if coated or oxidized and inspect alignment
Technician: check inlet air piping for blockage, proper length, elbows and termination
Technician: compare gas pressure to rating plate and adjust as needed
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: to clean or reposition the flame sensor and check gas pressure before this becomes a lockout.
